objective: Frozen computation: KF3, NN, NN2 and SEEDK from every bracketing of 5 to 8 to n = 40, the knot complex's Betti numbers and other knot readings at every step against the crossings; SEEDK's tiers.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 4 of 4 held): the four readings of the switch agree at all 11,050 steps of 420 runs from 105 bracketings; SEED with knot-local moves keeps two orders and recurs through full two-way grids in 105 of 105 runs; post hoc, later fills make loops (b1), and b2 rises exactly with a new filled knot.
title: The switch read from the knots along every run
